title: Lab 6 — RAG retrieval + grounded answers
description: Retrieval cases are free and deterministic (no model call): the expected document must appear in the fused top-k. Answer cases run the real grounded-generation path and check citations, expected facts, and correct refusal; the optional LLM judge scores faithfulness to the retrieved context.
